text.en:
12th. FEBRUARY, 2004 No. S 17

CURRENCY AND MONETARY ORDER, 2004 Notiftcation of Commencement In exercise of the power conferred by subsection (1) of section 1, the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st. February, 2004 as the date on which the Currency and Monetary Order, 2004 shall commence. Dated this 4th. day of Zulhijjah, 1424 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of January, 2004.

DATO PADUKA AWANG HAJI ABDUL RAHMAN BIN HAJI IBRAHIM Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
